title: StockSmart Credit Desk Note — Critical Bins Under a Credit Hold and Further Lead Days on Conversion
content:
**Rule.** For the customer-owned reorder point of a StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program bin converted from consignment at a par review, a bin whose entries of their latest date include one flagging it critical while the customer's Commercial Credit Account is on hold adds further lead days: 1 day where the hold reason is over limit or returned payments, 0.5 day for any other hold reason; a bin not so flagged, or an account not on hold, adds none.

**Records.** The bin's entries of their latest date are the entries of the converted item's bin carrying the most recent effective date; any one of them flagging the bin critical is enough. The status and hold reason are read from the customer's Commercial Credit Account.

| Latest-date entries include a critical flag | Credit account status | Hold reason | Further lead days |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | on hold | over limit | 1 day |
| yes | on hold | returned payments | 1 day |
| yes | on hold | any other reason | 0.5 day |
| yes | not on hold | — | none |
| no | any | — | none |

A critical flag carried only on an earlier-dated entry of the bin does not count.
